tips.text: Hit the daily cap with mission affinity first, then run the three Syndicate Alerts and turn in medallions, which ignore the cap.
Cap the day fast in Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, leaving around round 8, or in a couple of Duviri Circuit stages.
Run an Affinity Booster; standing is a share of affinity, so it roughly doubles what you earn while pledged.
Fill the cap in one run with an Equinox or Ivara sleep-and-slide-kill routine on Adaro, Sedna Exterminate.
Rank up as soon as you can afford it and have the Aya ready; standing past a rank's maximum is wasted.
Do not earn standing for another faction syndicate the same day; every pledged syndicate draws from the same daily cap.
Max Cephalon Suda and Arbiters of Hexis first if you want several syndicates, then pledge Steel Meridian, which raises Red Veil and leaves both alone.
Do not buy Scattered Justice for it; Vaykor Hek already has Justice built in and a weapon cannot carry two syndicate effects.
Buy the other Vaykor weapons on the same visit; they use the same General rank and give separate Mastery.
Players say buy it: it is Mastery either way and the grind is a routine part of syndicate progress.
